about: Chris Nickelson is an attorney who represents clients in the Fort Worth, Texas area. Chris Nickelson is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2014 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Chris Nickelson chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Texas Tech University School of Law and graduated in 1999. Chris Nickelson passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1999.
He represents clients with Family Law issues in Texas. He also represents clients with Appellate issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, Chris Nickelson has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
